text:
Evidence cautions against equating SASRec gains with learning temporal preferences. [Woolridge et al.](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-2955/paper8.pdf) shuffled training histories while preserving held-out targets: effects were generally modest outside MovieLens-1M, with shuffling improving Beauty. A [2026 preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19833) finds simple recency-weighted pairwise probes competitive with transformer recommenders, suggesting that transition associations can explain gains without higher-order sequence modeling. Neither finding establishes that a proposed short-term branch captures preference changes.

Recommended controlled ablations: compare baseline, last-item-only, equal-sized recent-window versus older-window pooling, whole-history pooling, and exponential recency weighting; keep embeddings, training budget, and tuning effort comparable. Compare learned gates against tuned fixed mixtures, including branch-off endpoints. Shuffle within windows while preserving membership and the final item, then separately shuffle window membership; distinguish inference perturbations from retraining controls. Recent pooling beating older pooling supports recency relevance; surviving within-window shuffling supports an unordered recent-interest explanation, not order modeling. Report paired validation differences by category, history length, and training-frequency popularity strata; inspect gate saturation and whether improvements concentrate on popular targets. These are proposed diagnostic controls, not established findings. Keep pinned sampled HR@10 for selection, but inspect full-catalog unseen-item popularity, coverage, and recommendation overlap for the twenty users. [Krichene and Rendle](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/0651.pdf) show sampled metrics can reverse algorithm rankings even in expectation; gains against 99 negatives therefore do not establish better full-catalog top-10 behavior. Unlabeled recommendation diagnostics cannot establish full-catalog accuracy or unobserved diversity/conformity traits.
